target_services.name: Shopify
target_services.research_notes: Published extension flowsteward.shopify 0.5.1 already covers Admin catalog/inventory/orders. Shopper UCP/customer MCP is a separate scope; do not replace the extension with it. Official current migration also maps policy/FAQ to Ask MCP ask_business on /api/ucp/mcp. Published merchant extension is the relevant foundation; storefront MCP does not replace Admin order/inventory automation. No native Shopify webhook surface in the current extension.
